subject: SCIENCE
title: Living or Nonliving?
objective: Use multiple characteristics as evidence when discussing living things.
introduction: Living organisms use energy, maintain internal processes, grow or develop, respond, and belong to reproducing life cycles; one visible sign alone is not enough.

vocabulary.definition: The power to do work, like light or heat.
How a living thing is born, grows, and changes.
A living thing that grows in soil and makes food.
